name: Zhatarn
desc:
Zhatarn is a Celestial, who used to reside in [the Heavens](location:the_heavens). He took from the Moonseye in pursuit of something, but couldn't withstand the power within it, which drove him insane. He wielded the Soulthorn blade.

After the incident he was exiled from [the Heavens](location:the_heavens) and set to roam the [Voidsea](location:voidsea) forever as a wraith.

Many years have passed since then and even many of the Lightborn think of it as of a cautionary tale, a myth. But the existence of the Soulthorn proves otherwise.
additional_info:
-   After his exile, his blade was found in the Moonseye by a Celestial traveler.
-   His status is currently unknown.
-   The Vow of Iron Memento "Prince of the Moon" is one of their followers, taking in their steps.
-   Given the Soulthorn's size and appearance, Zhatarn may have been of human-like proportions.
